01 / THE STARTING POINTORIGINAL IDENTITY · NEW COMPOSITION

The Uultis identity.
A new digital
dimension.

The wordmark, photography, and product information come from official Uultis channels. SuisseIntl and Athelas are the typefaces observed in the original identity.

The digital direction uses Inter and Libre Baskerville, openly licensed type families, and brings these foundations into an editorial language: generous space, natural tones, large images, and a contemplative pace of discovery.

The original design is preserved. The digital presentation uses the wordmark without the tagline beneath it, achieved by cropping the vector file’s view.

03 / TONE OF VOICEPROPOSED LANGUAGE FOR THE WEBSITE

Fewer words.
More room
to feel.

A calm, precise, and approachable voice. Headlines leave room for imagination; product information supports a considered choice. The language accompanies the experience with clarity and purpose.

Contemplative.

“Some things
are felt.”

Brief sentences and natural pauses. Image and text share the space, allowing time to observe.

Precise.

“Igriega.
Artur de Menezes.”

Name, designer, category, and genuine details. The content preserves the piece’s official information.

Approachable.

“Find the piece
that speaks to
your space.”

Simple invitations to discover, explore, and learn. The next action is clear, without interrupting the pace of the visit.

FROM INTENTION TO EXPERIENCEPRINCIPLES OF THE DIGITAL DIRECTION

Care lies
in
continuity.

Consistency emerges from the whole: image, word, space, and motion share the same intention at every moment of the visit.

  1. 01

    Give each piece room.

    Generous framing, quiet backgrounds, and space between information. The furniture guides the composition.

  2. 02

    Bring the eye closer.

    Alternate between the scale of an interior and the detail of a material. Navigation reveals new ways of seeing.

  3. 03

    Preserve clarity.

    Designer credits, descriptions, and next steps are easy to find on every screen.

  4. 04

    Respect the visitor’s pace.

    Gentle motion and natural navigation. The experience follows the rhythm of those exploring it.

Clear origins. Clear intent.
